title: Resetting your account password
content: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot password'. Enter the email address associated with your account. You will receive a password reset link valid for 30 minutes. The new password must be at least 10 characters and include one number and one special character. If using SSO (Google/Microsoft), password resets must be performed through your identity provider, not through our platform.

title: API authentication and rate limits
content: All API requests require a Bearer token passed in the Authorization header: 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'. API keys can be generated in Settings > Developer > API Keys. The default rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key, returned as 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header when exceeded. A 401 Unauthorized response indicates an invalid or expired key; keys expire after 12 months of inactivity. Webhook signatures are verified using HMAC-SHA256 against the X-Signature header.

title: Billing cycles and invoice generation
content: Subscriptions are billed monthly on the date of initial signup, or annually if an annual plan was chosen. Invoices are generated within 24 hours of payment and sent to the billing email on file, and can also be downloaded from Settings > Billing > Invoices. Refunds for accidental duplicate charges are processed automatically within 5-7 business days. Refunds for plan downgrades are prorated and credited to the next invoice rather than refunded directly, unless the account is being closed.

title: Upgrading or downgrading your plan
content: Plan changes can be made in Settings > Billing > Plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and are billed pro-rata for the remainder of the current cycle. Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle. Enterprise plans (50+ seats) require a custom contract; reach out to your account manager or sales@company.com for a quote. Enterprise contracts include a dedicated SLA, typically 99.9% uptime, and priority support response within 4 business hours.

title: Troubleshooting failed data syncs
content: Failed syncs are usually caused by one of three issues: (1) an expired API token on the connected account, (2) a schema mismatch where a required field was renamed or removed on the source system, or (3) a temporary timeout if the source system is processing more than 10,000 records in a single batch. Check Settings > Integrations > Sync Logs for the specific error code. Error code SYNC-409 indicates a conflicting concurrent sync; SYNC-422 indicates a schema validation failure and will include the offending field name in the log detail.

title: Exporting and deleting account data (GDPR)
content: Users can request a full export of their account data from Settings > Privacy > Export Data, which generates a downloadable ZIP within 48 hours. Account deletion requests permanently remove personal data within 30 days, per our retention policy, though anonymized usage logs may be retained for up to 12 months for security auditing. Enterprise admins can submit bulk data requests for all users on a workspace via the Admin Console.

title: Two-factor authentication (2FA) setup and recovery
content: 2FA can be enabled in Settings > Security using an authenticator app (TOTP) or SMS. During setup, 10 single-use recovery codes are generated; store these securely. If locked out and recovery codes are lost, identity verification is required via a support ticket including a government-issued ID, and account access is typically restored within 1-2 business days for security reasons.

title: Service status and uptime history
content: Current and historical service status is available at status.company.com, including incident postmortems for any outage longer than 15 minutes. For Enterprise customers with an SLA, any downtime beyond the contracted threshold qualifies for service credits, which must be requested within 30 days of the incident via your account manager.
